# ফ্রেশ খান (Fresh Khan)

> Fresh Khan is a Bangladesh-based multi-vendor organic marketplace connecting certified farmers and vendors directly with customers. Fresh vegetables, fruits, dairy, spices, and more delivered to your door.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Fresh Khan, featured organic products and vendors.
- [Products](/products): Browse all certified organic products across categories.
- [Vendors](/vendors): Directory of approved organic farmers and sellers.
- [About](/about): Our mission, story, and organic certification standards.

## Optional

- [Cart](/cart): Shopping cart page.
- [Checkout](/checkout): Order placement with Cash on Delivery, bKash, and Nagad options.
